series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: Gartner Predicts Video Telepresence Will Replace 2.1 Million Airline Seats Per Year by 2012, Losing the Travel Industry $3.5 billion annually
entries.subject: Video telepresence and air travel
entries.note: Quote is the press-release headline. Also: $3.5 billion annual loss to travel industry.

entries.quote: From 2009 to 2013 the server virtualisation software market will grow with a CAGR of 28 percent, rising from US$1.8bn to US$6.2bn.
entries.subject: Server virtualization software market

entries.quote: By 2011, 30 percent of Consulting and Systems Integration revenue will be delivered via 'cloud computing'
entries.subject: Cloud delivery of consulting and SI revenue
entries.metric: share of consulting and systems integration revenue delivered via cloud

entries.quote: Twenty-five percent of the top 20 BPO providers will not exist as separate entities by 2012.
entries.subject: BPO provider consolidation
entries.metric: share of top 20 BPO providers ceasing to exist as separate entities

entries.quote: By 2012, successful enterprises will actively encourage and reward more failures in order to find the optimal approach they want more quickly.
entries.subject: Rewarding failure in business process management

entries.quote: In 2012, the major PC vendors will recycle only one PC for every five they ship.
entries.subject: PC recycling
entries.metric: PCs recycled per PCs shipped by major vendors

entries.quote: By 2012, 30 percent of mobile PCs sold in the worldwide consumer market will be priced at less than US$300.
entries.subject: Low-cost mobile PCs
entries.metric: share of consumer mobile PCs priced under US$300

entries.quote: By year end 2013, 40 percent of enterprise knowledge workers will have abandoned or removed their desk phone.
entries.subject: Desk phone abandonment
entries.metric: share of enterprise knowledge workers without desk phones

entries.quote: By the end of next year 2010, most wireless operators will cease to offer unlimited (flat-rate) mobile data plans.
entries.subject: Unlimited mobile data plans
entries.note: Most wireless operators cease to offer unlimited mobile data plans.

entries.quote: By year end 2012, physical sensors will create 20 percent of non-video internet traffic.
entries.subject: Sensor internet traffic
entries.metric: share of non-video internet traffic created by physical sensors

notes: Edition covers '2009 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'Top 10 Predictions for 2009'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions. Client report: "Gartner's Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users, 2009 and Beyond: Where Is the Money?" (paywalled). gartner.com returns 403 to scripted fetches; text read from the Internet Archive snapshot listed in sources. Only public copy found is the Sydney release (Gartner Predicts 2009 briefing, February 6, 2009). It leads with the telepresence prediction and lists the other nine. The research note itself was likely published earlier (late 2008); no global press release found. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
